findings.statement: Canonical FR BTP cost model = DÉBOURSÉ SEC: main d'œuvre (cotisations sociales comprises) + matériaux + matériel/engins loués + sous-traitance + déplacement/transport, BEFORE frais de structure and marge. Margin per chantier = CA facturé − coût constaté; budget révisé = devis initial + modifications (avenants/TS) approuvées; alert when réel diverges from devis.
findings.implication: the engine must encode déboursé-sec cost categories + distinguish déboursé (bare cost) from frais de structure and from net profit — matches directive §2.2's 'ne pas confondre marge brute et bénéfice net'.

findings.statement: Real-time margin-per-chantier/affaire + budget-vs-réel variance + overrun alerts are the CORE competitive features (BatUp, Costructor, BTP-Chantier.fr, B2O ERP).
findings.implication: the margin + budget-vs-réel + alert engine is the right vertical; differentiation must come from the coherence/document-intelligence reconciliation already built (pièce-justificative↔coût traceability), not from basic margin maths.

findings.statement: Position the chantier-profitability engine as reconciliation-grounded (every cost traced to a justificatif, every anomaly explainable) — the reconciliation differentiator from V145/V147 — rather than competing on real-time dashboards alone.
